rating_source: Google Maps Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js): rating 4.7, 15 reviews, category 'Wood floor installation service'.

hours.source: Google Maps Business Profile hours block.

owner_source: Mentioned by name in at least 3 separate Google reviews (Robert DINH, Stefano, Alexander Delmas) as the owner who personally handles jobs and follow-up.
team_notes: One review (Robert DINH) also names an assistant, Valentina, described as ensuring efficient and thorough service.

services.name: Hardwood floor installation
services.source: Reviews describe new wood floor installs (Alexander Delmas: 'install new wood floors in my bedroom'); Google category is 'Wood floor installation service'.

services.name: Floor refinishing / sanding / repair
services.source: Reviews describe refinishing existing floors, including after water damage (Milton Hoare, Jennifer Bennett, Alexander Delmas).

services.name: Marble, mosaic and tile work
services.source: Observed directly in the business's own uploaded Google Maps photos: a marble/mosaic entry staircase, a hexagon-tile shower, and penny-tile bathroom floors, alongside the hardwood jobs. Framed on the site as part of the crew's range, not as a separately priced/named Booksy-style menu item, since no price list is published anywhere.

no_price_list: No services menu or price list is published anywhere (no website, no Google Business menu section). Site uses the adapted variant: 'priced on request' + call-for-quote CTA throughout, per pipeline rule.

reviews_used.author: Jennifer Bennett
reviews_used.text: mr. wood was recommended to us by two different family members who have recently refinished their floors. Our floors look amazing, the team got everything done in a tight time frame without sacrificing their amazing quality! We highly recommend!

reviews_used.author: Stefano
reviews_used.text: I have contracted Mr. Wood numerous times now. Every time a professional job and if there were ever complains from my clients, Andres the owner always came back with his crew and rectified the issues. Highly recommend!

reviews_used.author: Alexander Delmas
reviews_used.text: Andres was great to work with. He gave me a very fair price to refurbish my current wood floors as well as install new wood floors in my bedroom. The work came out excellent! I highly recommend this company!
